description: The exact per-decision settings Stage C (validation) must use, unmodified. Every version is explicit; there is no 'auto' or 'latest' setting. This file is immutable once its manifest exists: the manifest records its sha256 and the sha256 of every model-input-defining source file, and run_experiment --frozen-config refuses to run if any of them differ.

cohort.selection: the first 100 case ids of the dev split in stored order (the Stage B v1/v2 cohort)
cohort.decision_time: as_of = the case's own created_date (T0, ticket-only)

issue_category.state_projection: issue_category_state: ticket, customer tier/industry/size, reported product, visible signal count and types

root_cause.state_projection: root_cause_state at v4_operational: ticket, reported product, deployed components, technical evidence, operational events

causal_change.state_projection: causal_change_state: ticket, reported product, deployed components, technical evidence (changes and deployments are offered only as candidates)

owning_team.state_projection: owning_team_state: ticket, reported product, deployed components, evidence summary

evidence_sufficiency.state_projection: evidence_sufficiency_state with the time-gated observable telemetry-anomaly summary (evidence_sufficiency_v2)

incident_relationship.candidate_strategy: active_incidents_overlapping_case (one Noul question per overlapping incident)
incident_relationship.state_projection: incident_relationship_state: ticket, reported product, case signal count, candidate incident

context_version_note: context_version is a root-cause-only setting; every other decision ignores it.

jev.note: Pinned to the explicit version id (accepted by the API and resolving identically to the jev-latest alias on 2026-09-23); the alias is not used.

rationale.root_cause_context_v4: On the dev-100 cohort v5_graph reached 46% and v4_operational 45% (one case apart), while v4 sends about 18% fewer input tokens (1,479 vs 1,807 mean) at lower latency; v3_technical reached 32%. v4 is the preferred default. The choice rests on dev data only and is validated, not tuned, in Stage C.
rationale.root_cause_candidates_v2: Raised candidate recall from 68% to 100% on dev-100 at the cost of conditional accuracy (38.2% to 32.0%); end-to-end accuracy rose 26% to 32%. The cutoffs were chosen on this same cohort, so the recall is in-sample until Stage C (JEV-019).
rationale.owning_team_candidates_v2: Raised acceptable-team recall from 61% to 100% and acceptable accuracy from 38% to 49% on dev-100; in-sample for the same reason.
rationale.causal_change_candidates_v3: Fixes JEV-013: deployment-type causal changes were never offered under v2 (6 of 100 dev cases). Recall 94% to 100%, average candidate count 1.73 to 1.80.
rationale.evidence_sufficiency_v2: Kept although accuracy is low: the v1 result was a state-projection mismatch (no observable telemetry anomalies), which v2 corrects. The remaining weakness is a measured result that Stage C should test rather than a defect to keep tuning on dev.
rationale.issue_category_and_incident_relationship: Unchanged since Stage B; not retuned.
rationale.jev_model_pin: Removes alias drift as a source of change between Stage B and Stage C.
rationale.canonical_change_ids: Stage B v1/v2 and the v3 rerun all showed Jev the canonical change ids, so the freeze keeps them for comparability. The change-id number range separates true from non-true candidates in the dev cohort (see docs/JEV_EVALUATION.md); the opaque-key control run measures whether that matters.

stage_c_rule: Stage C must run with --frozen-config stage_b_frozen_v1 and no overrides. Any change to a version above requires a new freeze_version, not an edit to this file.
